verdict.rationale: Otter ships a built-in assistant, Otter AI Chat. It answers questions across meetings and connected apps, helps create follow-ups, reports and content, can query Salesforce/HubSpot, and auto-generates follow-up emails. The evidence shows a Q&A and drafting assistant rather than one you hand multi-step tasks to; pushing action items into Jira, Asana or Zendesk is described as automatic syncing, not work the assistant carries out on request. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant executes or delegates actions inside the product or in connected tools, documentation of what tasks the assistant can actually perform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
